blocks.title: Why Naive AI Wrappers Fail
blocks.description: Two quick questions about grounding and randomness.

questions.prompt: Why can asking an LLM for a random restaurant repeat the same suggestion?
options: Generation can favor common answers; a separate wheel randomizes selection
questions.explanation: Recommendation and random selection are separate jobs.

questions.prompt: Why pair Maps and Search grounding?
options: Maps helps with places and location; Search can surface web sources
questions.explanation: Distinct grounding sources can help verify different facts.

blocks.title: Three Layers of a Useful AI Feature
